title: Message Aggregator with Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB
description: Creates a Lambda function that groups and tracks messages using DynamoDB. Once messages are aggregated a new message is raised on a destination SQS queue.

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This CDK project demonstrate how to create a Message Aggregator pattern using Amazon SQS, AWS Lambda and Amazon DynamoDB.
The solution creates a source and a destination SQS Queue and a Lambda function that keeps track of the messages by leveraging a DynamoDB Table.
This architecture is an implementation of the Integration pattern: Message Aggregator explained in the Integration Patterns book.
See the GitHub repo for detailed testing instructions.
